entities.name: Andrew J. Rogers
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrew Jackson Rogers was an American lawyer, teacher, clerk, police commissioner, and Democratic Party politician who represented New Jersey's 4th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives for two terms from 1863 to 1867.
